angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 694,309 km at 150.18 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.6588 +/- 0.0158 mas (same row, RUWE 0.75): 150.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.998 +/- 0.033 solar radii from Ruggieri et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of XO-2 N b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract): 694,309 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.96 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Ruggieri et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of XO-2 N b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5290 +/- 18 K from Ruggieri et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-2 N b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Ruggieri et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-2 N b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/xo-2-n.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.422, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-2 N (pscomppars): spectral type G8 V, from Ruggieri et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+50 1471: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-2 N (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.37 dex, from Ruggieri et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-2 N (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.08823, from Baluev et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015MNRAS.450.3101B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-2 N (pscomppars): age 7.8 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-2 N (pscomppars): rotation period 28.6 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/A+A/705/A142/tablea1 (Physical properties study of planet systems), column Prot: 41.6 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-2 N (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.07 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.998 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.606. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
